reconciliation.title: Morning reconciliation
reconciliation.hint: to do every morning, with the balance TradeZero displays
reconciliation.negativeBalance: A negative balance is impossible — check the figure read on TradeZero.
reconciliation.note: No gap : the reconciliation is simply timestamped. With a gap, a « Correction » line puts the balance on the TradeZero figure.
reconciliation.balanceUnavailable: Computed balance unavailable : the reconciliation waits for it to reload — a gap measured against a stale balance would write a wrong correction.
reconciliation.doneCorrected: Reconciled this morning — a correction of {{gap}} $ was recorded.

confirmCorrection.title: Create the correction?
confirmCorrection.message: A « Correction » line of {{gap}} $ is added to the account so the balance matches the TradeZero figure. The reconciliation is timestamped with it.

confirmUnusualCorrection.title: Unusual gap — create it anyway?
confirmUnusualCorrection.message: The {{gap}} $ gap is more than 20 % of the computed balance ({{balance}} $). At that size it is most often a typo. Confirming writes a « Correction » line that rewrites the account balance.

confirmCancel.title: Cancel the reconciliation?
confirmCancel.message: This morning and the correction it produced will be removed, and the balance will go back to what it was before. Use it when the figure you typed was a mistake.

kpi.reconciliationGapHint: What the broker took outside the trades — locates, subscription, rounding. Read at the period's reconciled mornings : a row fixed since does not change it. Follows the dates, not the type filter.
kpi.locatesHint: The locates taken over the period. « Paid for nothing »: on a ticker with no trade that day — today's count once New York has closed (4 pm). An upper bound: a locate listed back and partly refunded counts in full, its refund being an adjustment. Follows the dates, not the type filter.

journal.title: Trading journal
journal.subtitle: One row per ticker and day, its trades when opened. A trade usually comes from a stat, and can stand alone.

kpi.allTraded: Every stat of the period was traded
kpi.outOfPatternHint: Trades taken on a stat the recorded prices say was out of pattern. A discipline number, not a strategy one : with the in-rules one, it makes the period's P&L.
kpi.lateEntriesHint: Win rate and average P&L of the trades entered at 11:00 or later, against the ones entered before — read off the first entry fill. A trade with no entry time counts on neither side.

filterPanel.entryHint: Read off the first entry fill — a trade with no time is in neither

journal.empty: No trade over this period. A trade is born from a stat, on the stats sheet.

confirmDelete.title: Delete the {{ticker}} trade?
confirmDelete.message: Permanent: executions, post-mortem and chart capture are deleted, and the trade's movement disappears from the account. The stat of the day is kept.

confirmDeleteAlone.title: Delete the {{ticker}} trade?
confirmDeleteAlone.message: Permanent: executions, post-mortem and chart capture are deleted, and the trade's movement disappears from the account.

fields.partialDuration: Trades with no fill times: {{missing}}. The cumulated duration leaves them out.

newTrade.title: New trade
newTrade.lead: The trade joins the stat of this day, ticker and pattern when there is one — otherwise a stat created later will take it. Without a stat, it counts in the journal and the account, not in the stats : an import, a session the sheet never studied.

kpi.byPatternSub: pick a pattern for the push, the LOD, the extension, the rejection… — never a mix
kpi.holdSub: PM high → open · cumulative at the open {{open}} · at the PM high {{pmHigh}}

kpi.dropSubTookTop: , {{count}} of them after the Apex was taken back
kpi.dropTargetSub: Sinks of at least {{target}} % from the sheet's entry
kpi.dropHint: What the move offered, not a backtest : the stop may have been hit before the Sink

fields.highInstitutionsHint: More than 20 % of the float held by institutions

fields.dropNotReadHint: The Sink was not read and will not be — the session was not watched to the end. The stat ticks without it ; typing a Sink takes the mark off.

fields.dtDurationHint: From the Base to the Echo ; below, the three legs
fields.briefHint: The figures that sum the stat up in its own pattern
fields.holdHint: PM high → open : what is left of the premarket at 9:30
fields.gapHint: Previous close → PM open ; under it, the cumulative up to the PM high — the highest the scanner showed
fields.openHint: Under it, the cumulative from the previous close — what the scanner still showed at the bell

confirmPromoteTrade.title: Create the {{ticker}} trade?

confirmDeleteWithTrade.title: Delete the {{ticker}} stat?
confirmDeleteWithTrade.message: Permanent. A trade is attached to it : it stays in the journal, without a stat — executions, P&L, post-mortem and account line kept, pattern unchanged. Its sheet will have no day context any more.

confirmDeleteWithTrades.title: Delete the {{ticker}} stat?
confirmDeleteWithTrades.message: Permanent. {{count}} trades are attached to it : they stay in the journal, without a stat — executions, P&L, post-mortem and account lines kept, pattern unchanged. Their sheets will have no day context any more.

chart.title: Chart
chart.hint: 1-min bars — 5-min over the day · New York time · extended hours shaded · a point off its candle turns amber

pending.title: The chart arrives tomorrow morning.
pending.body: A day's 1-min bars are served once the session is over : the scanner's next run fetches them for this stat. Nothing to do on your side.

notFound.title: No bars for {{ticker}} that day.
notFound.body: The scanner asked for them and nothing was served — a delisted ticker, or one that changed symbol. The stat reads without a chart.

chart.missingOne: {{points}} not typed yet — read it off the candles, its mark shows with the time and the price.
chart.missing: {{points}} not typed yet — read them off the candles, their marks show with the time and the price.
chart.off: Off its candle : {{points}} — check the price or the time.

premarket.title: Premarket —
premarket.hintDoubleTop: float and volume copied from the candidate · no premarket: a double top is read off the session
premarket.hint: copied from the candidate · editable · each field is saved when left
premarket.doubleTopFixed: A DT stat stays a DT: its prices mean nothing to another pattern
premarket.gusFixed: A GUS stat stays a GUS: a double top on the same day is another stat

create.title: New stat
create.hint: a chart found afterwards · any day up to today

save.premarketRequired: the three premarket prices are required
save.pmHighBelowPmOpen: the PM high is below the PM open
save.hodBelowLod: the HOD is below the LOD
save.aboveHod: a price sits above the HOD
save.belowLod: a price sits below the LOD
save.topBelowStart: the Apex is under the Base
save.lowAboveTop: the Rejection is above the Apex
save.retestBelowLow: the Echo is under the Rejection
save.timeOutOfOrder: the times go in order : Base, Apex, Rejection, Echo, Sink
save.dropTimeRequired: the Sink time, with its price
save.dropPriceRequired: the Sink price, with its time
save.gusDropBeforePush: the Sink comes before the Push
save.gusDropTimeRequired: the Sink time, with its price
save.gusDropPriceRequired: the Sink price, with its time
save.gusPushTimeRequired: the Push time, with the Sink

confirmCreate.title: Create the {{ticker}} stat?
confirmCreate.message: It joins the sheet like the morning's stats: one per day, ticker and pattern. Tick it once the session is complete.

confirmLeave.title: Leave without saving?
confirmLeave.message: A change could not be saved — the reason is next to the card's title. If you leave, the stat keeps its last saved values.

view.label: Pattern shown
view.hint: the KPIs, the table's columns and the averages follow the pattern — the stats measure only the GUS and the DT ; a SIR, SIV or discretionary trade is typed in the journal, with no stat

doubleTop.title: Double top
doubleTop.hint: late in the morning, when it forms · each price with its time · each field saves when you leave it · A ≥ 50 %, R 17-20 % · the Sink is filled at the close
doubleTop.startHint: the 9:30 open by default — the low the push starts from
doubleTop.legBBreath: R {{leg}} % — under 17 %: a breath rather than a rejection
doubleTop.columnAHint: From the Base to the Apex
doubleTop.columnBHint: From the Apex to the Rejection
doubleTop.columnCHint: From the Rejection to the Echo ; below, the distance to the Apex
doubleTop.breathHint: Under the 17 % of the DT sheet: a breath rather than a rejection
doubleTop.dropHint: required — the low of the first fall after the Echo
doubleTop.dropNotReadHint: not read — the stat ticks without it
doubleTop.dropTookTopHint: Apex taken back : no Sink to measure
doubleTop.legD: S {{gain}} % for the short · {{entry}} % at the sheet's entry
doubleTop.columnDHint: The low of the first fall after the Echo ; below, what the short makes from the Echo and from the sheet's entry (Apex −5 %), then the duration

sibling.label: Same ticker, another pattern
sibling.hint: The morning's GUS and the late-morning DT are two stats: same day, same ticker. Only while the other one does not exist yet.

confirmSibling.title: Create the {{pattern}} stat of {{ticker}}?
confirmSibling.message: Same day, same ticker: the day's float, volume and flags are carried over — a DT starts from the open with no premarket, a GUS takes the candidate's premarket. It has its own trades and only counts in its pattern's stats.

confirmAnotherTrade.title: Create another {{ticker}} trade?
confirmAnotherTrade.message: A new empty trade on the same stat: same pattern, its own direction, executions, P&L and post-mortem. The existing trades don't change. Under another pattern, it's another stat: « Same ticker, another pattern ».

derived.label: Filters derived from the prices
derived.OUT_OF_PATTERN_HINT: What the recorded prices say was not the setup — a DT whose Echo takes the Apex back, a GUS outside the sheet's price range. Combines with the tabs.
derived.UNDER_1_DOLLAR_HINT: Open under $1 — derived from the price, no longer a box. Combines with the tabs.

outOfPattern.RETEST_TOOK_TOP: The Echo takes the Apex back : a breakout, not a double top
outOfPattern.PRICE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The open is outside the sheet's price range (~$0.30 – $10)

gus.columnHint: The low of the first fall after the Push ; below, what the short makes from the Push's top (from the open on a no-push day), then the time and the duration
gus.fromOpen: from the open — no push · {{minutes}} min
gus.hint: optional — often the LOD ; higher when the LOD came before the Push, above the Push when the stock kept going up
gus.notReadHint: not read — out of the Sink figures
gus.toFillHint: Completed before the Sink existed : the low of the first fall after the Push is still to record. Optional for now, it feeds « 15 % reached ».

rejected.hint: The scanner stats rejected, with their reason — kept so a new scan does not bring them back. Hidden everywhere else. Combines with the tabs.

tagHint.TO_REVIEW: Dropped by the scanner on {{created}} — out of the figures until validated
tagHint.VALIDATED: Dropped by the scanner, validated — a stat like any other, its source still shown
tagHint.REJECTED: Rejected — kept so a new scan does not bring it back, and to tune the detector on its points

review.openHint: Open the stat to check and correct its prices before deciding
review.validateHint: It joins its pattern's stats, to complete : you tick it afterwards, like a typed stat
review.rejectHint: Reject — it leaves everything and will not come back on the next scan
review.unvalidateHint: Undoes the validation : back to review, out of the figures
review.untickFirst: Completed : untick it before sending it back to review
review.tickBlocked: To review first : Validate or Reject
review.banner: on {{created}}, read on the 1-min bars of {{day}} — check its prices on the chart and correct them here. Correcting does not validate it : it stays to review, out of the figures, until « Validate ».
review.bannerValidated: — a stat like any other, edited like them. « Back to review » takes it out of the figures until validated again.
review.bannerRejected: — out of every figure, kept so a new scan does not bring it back. « Restore » sends it back to review.
review.bannerRejectedBecause: — reason : {{reason}}. Out of every figure, kept so a new scan does not bring it back. « Restore » sends it back to review.

rejectionReason.BREAKOUT: Breakout — the Echo took the Apex
rejectionReason.ECHO_TOO_FAR: Echo too far from the Apex
rejectionReason.NEWS: A news behind it — a fundamental

confirmReject.title: Reject the {{ticker}} stat?
confirmReject.message: It leaves the table and every figure, and a new scan will not bring it back. It stays under « Rejected », where it can be restored.

move.title: Percent move
move.description: How far a price moved, in %, from one price to another — or the reverse: the price a given move leads to.

max.title: Max size
max.description: The largest size the broker will accept on this stock — to place the order once, without it coming back refused.
max.boundByMargin: Bound by the margin: {{shares}} shares at {{perShare}} $/share.
max.boundByCeiling: Bound by your ceiling of {{ceiling}} % of the balance.
max.locatesPaid: Locates are paid whether the trade is taken or not.
max.underLot: Not even one lot: the margin or the ceiling doesn't allow it.

size.title: Position size
size.description: How many shares to short at each entry level above the open, so that a stop never costs more than the risk you chose.
size.aboveStop: The current price is above the stop: the trade is invalidated, no level to take.
size.noLevel: The stop is under the first entry level (+5 %): no level left to short from.
size.tooFar: With this risk, the stop is too far: not even one share.
size.refused: In amber: the margin exceeds the usable buying power ({{usable}} $) — the order would be refused.

rr.title: Distance and R:R
rr.description: Before entering: the distance to the stop and to the target, and what you risk for what you aim at.
rr.stopWrongSide: On a short, the stop goes above the price.
rr.targetWrongSide: On a short, the target goes below the price.

broker.title: Broker rules
broker.remembered: Broker settings, kept from one visit to the next.

postit.title: Post-it {{n}}
postit.placeholder: An idea, a level, a rule to keep in mind…

settings.subtitle: Display preferences, and for the administrator : access, data, lexicon and ops links.

lexiconPage.title: Lexicon
lexiconPage.description: Admin-only — manage the shared trading glossary (add, edit, delete terms). The read-only view is available to everyone under « Lexicon » in the main navigation.

dataPage.title: Data
dataPage.description: Download the journal and the stats sheet as CSV. Export only : a trade is typed, from its stat or on its own, a stat is born from a candidate — there is no way in through a file.

journal.title: Journal
journal.subtitle: Download the trades as a CSV
journal.description: One line per trade, newest first.

format.encoding: UTF-8 with BOM, RFC 4180 — opens cleanly in Excel.
format.columns: 16 columns — identity, position, the three P&L figures (computed, real, retained) and the post-mortem.
format.executions: The fills travel packed in one cell : time|kind|shares|price, in fill order.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: Download the stats sheet as a CSV
stats.description: One line per stat, newest first.

format.encoding: UTF-8 with BOM, RFC 4180 — opens cleanly in Excel.
format.columns: 18 columns — premarket block, session block and flags. No percentage : they are derived from the prices.
format.pending: The session cells come out as filled, and a last column says whether the stat is ticked.

preferencesPage.title: Preferences
preferencesPage.description: Profile, theme, language and the currency the balance is displayed in.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: « System » follows the light / dark setting of your computer, live.

language.label: Language
language.description: Interface language. The lexicon keeps its own FR / EN toggle.

currency.label: Balance display currency
currency.description: The account stays in USD ; the CAD conversion uses the day's ECB reference rate.

opsLinksPage.title: Ops links — dashboards & billing
opsLinksPage.description: Shortcuts to the external consoles used to operate the app. Every link opens in a new tab — the running session stays intact.

billing.title: Billing — every card on file
billing.description: Centralised view of the billing dashboards where a credit card is on file. Check weekly to avoid end-of-month surprises.

hosting.title: Hosting & compute (GCP)
hosting.description: Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, OAuth, billing — project `trade-496613`.

database.title: Database (Supabase)
database.description: Project `portfolioai-prod` in Toronto (`ca-central-1`). Active connection mode: Session pooler IPv4.

cdn.title: DNS & CDN (Cloudflare)
cdn.description: Registrar `tickerstory.org`, Worker `tickerstory-proxy` (custom-domain proxy → Cloud Run), Cache Rules.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: GlitchTip for errors (Sentry-compatible), UptimeRobot for external availability.

github.title: GitHub — `jv3n/trade`
github.description: Actions, Releases, Environments, Secrets — where the deploy pipeline runs and the repo is audited.

links.gcpBilling: Cloud Run + Artifact Registry + Secret Manager billing. Durable free tier, watch the egress quota (1 GB/mo N. America).
links.supabaseBilling: Free tier 500 MB DB + 50K MAU. Card on file to absorb an overage without downtime.
links.cloudflareBilling: Card on file for the `tickerstory.org` registrar (~$7.50/yr at-cost). R2 free tier 10 GB as long as we stay under.
links.tickerstoryDomain: Cloudflare custom domain (Worker proxy → Cloud Run Montréal).
links.cloudRunDirect: Raw Cloud Run URL — fallback when Cloudflare is suspected.
links.supabaseBackups: Native Supabase daily snapshots — independent from our weekly `pg_dump → R2`.
links.cloudflareWorker: Intercepts `tickerstory.org/*` and forges a `fetch()` to Cloud Run with rewritten Host header.
links.glitchtipOrg: Overview + alert rules (instant email on new issue + burst >10 events/h) + free-tier quota 5K events/mo.

accessControlPage.title: Access control
accessControlPage.intro: Emails allowed to complete Google sign-in. Empty = open mode: any Google account is accepted (created as USER). Once you post the first entry, gating takes effect on the next fresh sign-in.
accessControlPage.adminNote: Admin emails (APP_ADMIN_EMAILS env var) are automatically included in the effective list — no need to re-add them here.
accessControlPage.openModeNote: Open mode is active: the list is empty. Add at least one email to start gating sign-ins.
accessControlPage.emptyHint: No emails in the list. Open mode is active — use the field below to add the first.

errors.load: Could not load the access list.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: What the account and the stats already hold — nothing new is entered here.

flow.clickHint: Click a segment to open its movements in Account
flow.loadError: The account flow could not be loaded.

rules.title: Mechanical rules
rules.windowHint: Rolling, up to today — independent of the stats period filter

columns.ruleHint: Entry at open + x %, stop at open + y %, covered at the EOD otherwise
columns.triggeredHint: GUS whose HOD reached the entry — the others did not trigger
columns.winsHint: Covered at the EOD below the entry
columns.averageLossHint: Stopped, or covered at the EOD at or above the entry
columns.ratioHint: Average win ÷ average loss — a hit rate alone says nothing
columns.expectancyHint: What a trade makes on average, in % of the entry

rules.note: Replayed on the open, HOD and EOD of every completed GUS — the rule, not my trades. Under {{min}} triggered trades, the row shows « — » and its n: a rate over a handful of rows says nothing.
rules.loadError: The rules could not be loaded.
